newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Six Bangladeshi workers killed in landslide.
newsitem.headline: Six Bangladeshi workers killed in landslide.

text.p: At least six Bangladeshi construction workers were killed by a landslide on Thursday in the resort town of Cox's Bazar, police said.
Police said tonnes of soil from a hill buried the workers as they were digging to make way for construction of a building.
They said four bodies had been retrieved while rescue workers were still sifting through soil for two other victims.
